state: Evaluate specification coherence only. CanCatch currently targets instrumented JavaScript errors, using existing CanLang verified event types, committed queue work, one D1 authority, canonical completed files, expiry and viewer policies. Implementation is deferred. The proposed deployment mapping chooses Project from configured intake credential and source; browser keys are write-only public handles and do not establish truthful reports. The wire schema requires id,time,message with optional constrained stack,environment,release and fingerprint, enforcing256KiB UTF8 before parsing. Forbidden context and credential-bearing URL pieces are removed before all persistence/grouping. Fingerprints hash canonical JSON viaSHA256: supplied explicit key, otherwise exception type with recognized normalized ordered frames, otherwise normalized message. Version/environment partition issues; release belongs to occurrence evidence; source-map retrieval is excluded. Both admission and consumer reject events older than7days or farther than5minutes ahead. A project UTC-day quota counts unique admitted reports; content-bound receipts and durable intent commit with that decision. Minimal digest tombstones span retries beyond payload deletion, and age enforcement bars expired identity reuse.202 acknowledges that commit only. Operational health uses verified source snapshots with persistent monotonically ordered revisions, nondecreasing accepted/rejected/dropped/processing_failed totals and rejection of unequal contents at one revision. Lack of a snapshot is unknown, not zero. Per-alert Notice rows preserve new/regression outcomes independently; disabled projects stop undispatched notices and deleted parents cannot be rebuilt from queued input. Existing CanDo std.ErrorsV1 goes through the pinned adapter mapping. Free text is still untrusted after redaction, and actual versioned normalizer/redactor test vectors and runtime evaluation are not supplied. Does this boundary constitute a coherent draft rather than silently inventing a running service?

coherence.instructions: Determine whether the described draft boundaries fit together without a hidden privilege, replay or delivery assumption. Express uncertainty and avoid certifying untested code.
